instruction: Set the font of all text in the document to Verdana.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text in the Dublin Zoo document from Georgia to Verdana font. The evaluator checks that every run in every paragraph has font.name == 'Verdana'. Verified with document structure: 19 paragraphs, 21 runs total, all currently in Georgia font.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: all text must be changed to Verdana font
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('font_name'), not expected.get('rules'))
Complete coverage: iterates through all paragraphs and all runs to check font.name property
Postconfig correctly saves the file with Ctrl+S before retrieval, ensuring fresh state
Comparison logic is appropriate: strict equality check for font name with binary scoring (1.0 or 0.0)
Data flow is correct: getter retrieves saved DOCX -> metric loads with python-docx -> checks all run fonts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add explicit handling for None font names with a comment, though current behavior (failing the check) is correct
